<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/appointments/{appointmentId}/cancellations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Cancels a `BOOKED` or `CHECKED_IN` appointment and frees its door window. `reason` is `CARRIER_REQUEST` or
`SITE_REQUEST` (the dock planner); `TURNED_AWAY` (gate refusal) and `ASN_CANCELLED` (every ASN cancelled) are set only by
the service. Requires an `Idempotency-Key`; `If-Match` is honoured. Publishes `DockAppointmentCancelled`.
